readings.whats_new: SPY edged up to 730.96 (-0.20%) from 730.32 an hour ago, still above the ~727 low; small caps strengthened (IWM ~+1%). A 20-year Treasury auction was reported to clear at 5.459% with solid demand; VIX/fear-greed snapshot unchanged since 16:10Z.
